import hashlib,os,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
path=Path(".cache/phase2/pre-migration-started.dump")
with path.open("xb") as output:
    os.chmod(path,0o600)
    result=subprocess.run(["docker","compose","exec","-T","postgres","pg_dump","-U","research","-d","research","--format=custom"],stdout=output,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
if result.returncode: raise RuntimeError("Private backup failed")
print("Private backup bytes:",path.stat().st_size,"SHA256:",hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
